decisions: Use Supabase Auth for identity and PostgreSQL membership and role rows as the sole authorization source of truth.
Keep platform ownership and policy helpers in a non-exposed private schema, with exact helper execution needed by RLS and no authenticated schema usage.
Use composite foreign keys, explicit Data API grants, forced RLS, and append-only audit triggers as overlapping tenant-integrity controls.
Disallow public account creation in application UX and checked-in configuration; require hosted Auth configuration reconciliation before release.
